description: Look up JavaScript and TypeScript packages on JSR, the open-source registry from the Deno team. Search packages by name or scope and the runtimes they work on; read a package with its install commands, its score, its versions, one version's licence, exports and provenance, its dependencies and full dependency tree, the packages that depend on it, its downloads, its files and the text of any one of them, and the symbols its documentation lists; read a scope, its packages and members, and a user; and list new, updated and featured packages and the registry's totals. Triggers start a workflow when a package publishes a new version or a scope publishes a new package. Every action reads public data and changes nothing. No account or API key required.
